latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Massblogger skill, enabling AI-powered WordPress and content operations via Massblogger's hosted MCP server.

- Connects OpenClaw agents to Massblogger for full remote management of WordPress sites (posts, pages, categories, tags, media, menus, users, and more).
- Supports native Massblogger features: AI content generation, pSEO, bulk automation, and cross-site pipelines without any local install.
- Requires only an MCP token; all sensitive WordPress credentials are managed inside Massblogger.
- Includes setup instructions for easy configuration in OpenClaw, with options for secure token management and header interpolation.
- Comprehensive tool catalog for granular control of WordPress functions, plus safety features like server-enforced publish guard.
